run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the best zero index to flip for the longest sequence of ones in a binary array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled by running the main block with multiple parameter sets
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds the optimal zero-to-one flip index for longest continuous ones sequence
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that tracks previous zero positions to compute the longest ones sequence after flipping one zero
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to accept the full array length automatically instead of requiring an explicit n parameter
